children: Williams priced a $2.75 billion senior notes offering including 5.000% due 2029 and 6.400% due 2056, with expected settlement on September 10, 2026.
Priced $500M 5.000% Senior Notes due 2029 at 99.931% of par; expected settlement Sept 10, 2026.
Priced $1.0B 5.600% Senior Notes due 2033 at 99.999% of par as part of the registered offering.
Priced $750M 5.800% Senior Notes due 2036 at 99.819% and $500M 6.400% Senior Notes due 2056 at 99.800%.
Net proceeds to repay commercial paper and for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures.
Underwriting led by Citigroup, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley and SMBC Nikko; offering registered on Form S-3.
